title: Login page shows a clear error for a wrong password
objective: A user who types a wrong password is told so in one sentence.
acceptance: POST /login with a known email and a wrong password returns 401 with error code WRONG_PASSWORD
The login page renders the text 'Wrong password' when the response code is WRONG_PASSWORD
After a wrong password the password input is empty and the email input keeps its value
outline: api/auth.py login handler returns the code; web/login.tsx maps it to the message.
test_plan: Verifier writes cases for all three acceptance items (API test + component test).
token_basis: two small files to change (api/auth.py, web/login.tsx), three short cases, no new dependencies
